shared_or_similar_visual_information: The direction of a marked trace on a number line or function graph. Compare the raised trace attached to the number-line mark at 2 in the left image with the raised trace attached to the number-line mark at 2 in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The ray selects values above 2. Right image: The indicated ray selects the values below its boundary.
Rationales: The selected left cue selects values on the larger-input side of the boundary. The selected right cue selects values on the smaller-input side of the boundary, so the two constraints differ in how they admit values.
